This binding may influence the activity of Slc22a3, which in turn participates in the transport of quaternary ammonium groups across the membrane. The involvement of Slc22a1 in these processes implies a potential functional relationship where Lamivudine could modulate the activity of Slc22a1 through its interaction with Slc22a3. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism by which Lamivudine affects Slc22a1, although the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
